## Verdict

**Merge with changes.** 99 findings, 0 high, max `agent_risk` 0.42 — nothing here is a stop-the-line defect. But 7 findings describe a real single-source-of-truth problem in the invoice-status path that gets more expensive after merge, so I'd block on those and let the rest ride.

**Tally: 7 block · 10 warn · 82 ignore.**

The single most important thing in this report is not any individual finding: **47 of 99 findings (all 46 `exact_duplicate_block` + the shape dupe) are one root cause** — this repo ships `starter` and `final` variants of the same apps side by side. Fix the scan config, not the code.

## Rubric

| Category | Test |
|---|---|
| **Block merge** | `agent_risk ≥ 0.38` **and** `confidence ≥ 0.85` **and** the finding describes drift-prone domain logic or actively misleading text an agent will read. Cheap to fix now, silently expensive later. |
| **Warn** | Finding is real but the fix is a design decision (extract/inject/parameterise), or `agent_risk` is mid-band (0.26–0.39) with `severity ≤ 0.45`. Log it; don't gate on it. |
| **Ignore** | `agent_risk < 0.20`, **or** the finding's premise is defeated by context (build-time code, tutorial fixture layout, mass nouns, photos). |

---

## BLOCK MERGE (7)

### `duplicated_role_status_plan_check` — 2 findings
| ID | Sev | agent_risk | Conf |
|---|---|---|---|
| crime_00065 | medium (0.55) | 0.32 | 0.70 |
| crime_00066 | medium (0.55) | 0.32 | 0.70 |

`agent_risk` alone (0.32) wouldn't clear my bar — the evidence does. `"pending"` and `"paid"` are each compared in **4 files using 2 distinct expression shapes** (`invoice.status === "pending"` in the forms, `status === "pending"` in `status.tsx`), with the form and the badge disagreeing on shape. There is no `InvoiceStatus` enum or policy helper anywhere in the report. Adding a third status is a four-site edit with no compiler help, and this is exactly the class of change an agent gets 3-of-4 right. `test_gap` 0.5 with zero tests means nothing catches the miss.

### `magic_domain_literal_scatter` — 1 finding
| ID | Sev | agent_risk | Conf |
|---|---|---|---|
| crime_00006 | medium (0.5) | **0.41** | 0.85 |

Second-highest `agent_risk` in the whole report, and it's the same defect as above seen from the other side: `"status"` as a raw string across `actions.ts` (Zod schema key) and four form components. Blocking these three together, not separately — one fix (`app/lib/invoice-status.ts` exporting the enum + `isPending`/`isPaid`) closes all three.

### `commented_out_code` — 4 of 10 findings
| ID | File | Sev | agent_risk | Conf |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| crime_00007 | `starter-example/app/query/route.ts:21-25` | medium (0.45) | 0.39 | 0.90 |
| crime_00008 | `starter-example/.../latest-invoices.tsx:19-56` | medium (0.45) | 0.39 | 0.90 |
| crime_00009 | `starter-example/.../revenue-chart.tsx:33-62` | medium (0.45) | 0.39 | 0.90 |
| crime_00010 | `starter-example/.../pagination.tsx:17-50` | medium (0.45) | 0.39 | 0.90 |

38, 34, and 30 consecutive commented lines of real JSX and control flow. `agent_risk` 0.39 at `confidence` 0.90, `effort: quick` — the cost of clearing these is a delete, and the cost of keeping them is an agent reviving a stale `latestInvoices.map` implementation that no longer matches the live one.

**Caveat that flips this:** all four sit in `starter-example`, and given the `starter`/`final` pairing this is almost certainly deliberate tutorial scaffolding. If so, downgrade to warn and require a `// TODO(step-N):` marker on each block so the intent is legible to a reader who doesn't know the repo.

---

## WARN (10)

### `commented_out_code` — remaining 6
`crime_00011`–`crime_00016`. Same `agent_risk` (0.39, one at 0.37) but `severity` drops to 0.25 and the blocks are short and ambiguous — a 2-line `console.log`/`await delay` pair (00013, 00014), a 3-line empty-state guard (00012), a 4-line `Response.json` (00015). Confidence slides to 0.80–0.86. Worth deleting; not worth a gate.

### `duplicate_component_shape` — 1
`crime_00064`, medium / `agent_risk` 0.32 / `confidence` 0.70. The only duplication finding in the report with an **intra-app** pair: `final-example/create-form.tsx:142-150` ↔ `final-example/edit-form.tsx:152-160` (same status radio fieldset). Real, and it's the same status concept as the blocking cluster — but extracting a shared component is a judgement call at 0.70 confidence, so warn.

### `direct_date` — 1 of 3
`crime_00067`, `final-example/app/lib/actions.ts:57`, low / `agent_risk` 0.28 / `confidence` 0.90. A genuine clock read stamping the invoice date inside a server action. `test_gap` 0.5 — untestable without monkey-patching. Warn: real temporal coupling, but injecting a clock into a Next.js server action is more ceremony than this PR needs.

### `oversized_raster` — 2 of 6
`crime_00095`, `crime_00096` — `hero-desktop.png`, **486.6 KB**, in both examples. `agent_risk` 0.14 (lowest band in the report — correctly, an agent won't be misled by a big PNG), but page weight on a landing hero is a real user-facing cost and the fix is a re-encode. Warn on perf grounds, not risk grounds.

---

## IGNORE (82)

### `exact_duplicate_block` — 46 · `agent_risk` 0.32–0.33
Every single one is a **cross-example** pair or group: `dashboard/final-example` ↔ `dashboard/starter-example`, five `basics/*-starter`/`*-final` variants of the same `lib/posts.js`, `seo/` ↔ `seo/demo/`. These are independent tutorial apps that are *supposed* to be near-identical snapshots. "Each fix has to land in every copy" is false — they're not meant to stay in sync. Note the `blast_radius` of 0 on most of them, which corroborates it.

**Action isn't a code change — it's a config change.** Scope the scan per example directory (or exclude `*-starter`) so these 46 stop drowning the 7 that matter.

### `sync_io_in_hotpath` — 6 · `agent_risk` 0.42 / 0.36
Highest `agent_risk` in the report, and I'm still ignoring all six — the premise doesn't hold. `getSortedPostsData` and `getAllPostIds` in `lib/posts.js` are Next.js static-generation data loaders; the `fs.readdirSync`/`readFileSync` runs at build time, not per request, so there is no event loop to block. In a request handler these 0.42s would be my top blocking item. Here, `confidence` 0.90 is measuring "this is sync I/O" correctly and inferring the wrong consequence.

### `raster_should_be_vector` — 12 · `agent_risk` 0.16
Every file is `public/customers/<person-name>.png` — 56×56 and 60×60 avatar **photographs**. SVG is not a substitute for a photo. The detector is matching on dimensions alone.

### `design_token_escape` — 8 · `agent_risk` 0.26
Hard-coded `px` values in form and skeleton JSX. There is no design token system in this repo to escape *from* — nothing to point the fix at. Flips to warn the moment a spacing/size scale exists.

### `direct_date` — 2 of 3 · `agent_risk` 0.28
`crime_00068`, `crime_00069` — both `app/lib/utils.ts:14`, inside `formatDateToLocal`. That's `new Date(dateString)` **parsing a caller-supplied string**, which is deterministic. The detector's own summary ("each call observes wall time at runtime") doesn't apply.

### `singular_plural_type_mismatch` — 2 · `agent_risk` 0.26, `confidence` 0.70
`revenue: Revenue[]` — "revenue" is a mass noun; renaming it to `revenues` makes it worse. Use the escape hatch the finding suggests: add `revenue` to `detectors.options.singular_plural_type_mismatch.allowedNames`.

### `deep_import` — 2 · `agent_risk` 0.26
`react-syntax-highlighter/dist/cjs/styles/prism` is that package's **documented** way to import a style — the styles aren't re-exported from the root. The detector's premise ("reaching past a package's published surface") is right in general and wrong for this specifier.

### `oversized_raster` — 4 of 6 · `agent_risk` 0.14
`opengraph-image.png` ×2 at 237 KB — social-card images aren't on the render path. `seo/**/large-image.jpg` ×2 at 422 KB — it's named `large-image.jpg` and it's the subject of the SEO demo.

---

## Detector-tuning notes

Ignoring 82% of a report is a signal about the scanner, not the code. Four of the ignore groups are false-premise rather than low-priority, and each has a concrete fix:

- **`sync_io_in_hotpath`** — suppress or downgrade when the enclosing function is only reached from `getStaticProps`/`getStaticPaths`/`generateStaticParams`. Build-time I/O isn't a hot path.
- **`raster_should_be_vector`** — dimensions alone over-fire. Gate on colour-count or entropy so photos don't read as icons.
- **`direct_date`** — distinguish `new Date()` (clock read) from `new Date(arg)` (parse). Two of three findings here are the latter.
- **`singular_plural_type_mismatch`** — ship a default mass-noun list (`revenue`, `data`, `info`, `metadata`) rather than making every project rediscover it.

And the structural one: `exact_duplicate_block` has no notion of parallel example trees, so a fixture-shaped repo yields 46 findings with a single cause. Suppressing duplicates whose only differing path segment matches a `*-starter`/`*-final`/`demo` pattern would cut this report in half without losing a real signal.
